description: Fetch one page by id: metadata always ({ id, title, url, project, views, live, workEmailGated, hasDraft, createdAt, updatedAt, visibility }), plus the stored HTML when include_html is true. Read-only. Use it to read a page before editing it with update_page; use list_pages to find ids or browse. Fails with page_not_found if the id is not in this space or the page was deleted.

include_html.description: Default false. true adds `html`: the document exactly as stored (the source you or the maker published, before serve-time injections). Can be large; only ask for it when you need the content.

page_id.description: The page id: the `id` field from publish_page or list_pages (also the last path segment of the page URL, …/docs/<page_id>). Only pages in the connected maker's space are visible.

name: get_page
title: Get one page
